mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY growth turns negative.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate margins, which in turn predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags the S&P 500 lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in consumer savings (RSAFS) indicates a tightening monetary stance coupled with reduced household liquidity, which amplifies the transmission to equity valuations and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND RSAFS falls in the same month
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with liquidity drain
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp month-on-month increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related earnings and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month moving average in the current month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A co-movement between rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a deepening labor market weakness, which reduces consumer demand and corporate profitability, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises AND PAYEMS falls in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 4% for three consecutive months and FEDFUNDS remains below 2%, it signals a delayed policy response to inflation, which erodes real corporate earnings and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 4% for 3 consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 4% for three months and FEDFUNDS remains below 2%.
